class.fantasyrpg.warrior.desc: A melee fighter who builds momentum with sword strikes and unleashes heavy blows and mana slashes.
class.fantasyrpg.warrior.play: Best for: fighting up front and keeping combos going
class.fantasyrpg.knight.desc: A knight who gathers resolve through guards and parries, holding the line with charges and counters.
class.fantasyrpg.knight.play: Best for: precise blocking to create openings
class.fantasyrpg.rogue.desc: An assassin who carves marks with rapid hits and detonates them from the shadows.
class.fantasyrpg.rogue.play: Best for: slipping behind enemies for vital strikes
class.fantasyrpg.archer.desc: A marksman who keeps distance, builds focus and fires piercing shots and elemental arrows.
class.fantasyrpg.archer.play: Best for: aiming from afar at weak points
class.fantasyrpg.mage.desc: A mage who wields arcane spells and solid mana bolts, chaining one spell into the next.
class.fantasyrpg.mage.play: Best for: chaining spells to control wide areas
class.fantasyrpg.cleric.desc: A battle priest who heals, smites and exorcises with mace and divine power.
class.fantasyrpg.cleric.play: Best for: enduring and protecting yourself and allies
